whatItDoes: Limits El Camino Healthcare District directors to four full four-year terms that begin on or after December 1, 2026. Partial terms and terms served before that date do not count toward the limit.
yesMeans: Approve the bylaw change creating this four-full-term limit, with partial terms and terms before December 1, 2026 excluded.
noMeans: Keep the current District bylaws, which place no limit on the number of terms a director may serve.

parts.label: Which terms count
parts.what: The limit counts full four-year terms beginning on or after December 1, 2026.

parts.label: Which terms do not count
parts.what: Partial terms, including an appointment to fill a vacancy, do not count. Full or partial terms served before December 1, 2026 also do not count.
